step1.title: Experience (XP)
step1.body: XP is your growth currency. 1000 XP = a new level. Complete protocols, habits and missions to earn XP.

step2.title: Departments
step2.body: Departments are your tools: Planning, Habits, Focus, Breathing, Meditation. Tap a card to enter a module.

step3.title: Daily Vanguard
step3.body: A daily activity ranking. The day's top operatives earn bonus rewards.

step4.title: Navigation
step4.body: The bottom bar is your HQ navigation: Hub (file), Operations (dashboard), Garage (shop), Hall of Fame (ranking).

step5.title: Personnel File
step5.body: The Hub is your personal file: level, awards, medals vault, settings. You can replay this tour from here too.

step6.title: Garage
step6.body: The customization shop. Spend Design Points (DP) on avatar frames, profile backgrounds and stat styles.

step7.title: Hall of Fame
step7.body: The global ranking of all operatives. Seasonal rewards for the top performers.

complete.title: TOUR COMPLETE
complete.body: You're ready for operations, operative. Good luck on your journey.
